headline: Goods worth more than RD$37 million seized in Chinese trade
summary: Dominican authorities seized over 78,000 products valued at 37 million pesos in four simultaneous raids on Asian-owned commercial establishments in Bonao. Goods included expired items and products lacking health registration.
why: Enforcement against unregistered or mislabelled imports affects retail competition and the regulatory compliance costs of importers in the Dominican Republic.
original_headline: Decomisan mercancías por más de RD$37 millones en comercio chino
